ValidationRule.description: Validation Rule to update correct client account before closing case when the associated account is INSPERITY SERVICES, L.P.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Require_Correct_Client_Account ) , ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed" ) , ( NSP_Category__c = "WX/WA" ) , ( Account.Name = "INSPERITY SERVICES, L.P." ) )
